disagreements.title: Open-day marker on phones is only an 8 px green dot (colour and shape alone)
disagreements.a_reason: A narrower statement of D06, whose description names the same mechanism: "only session days carry the word 'Open' (a green dot on a phone)". On a phone members cannot tell open days from closed ones, which is why they choose closed days, and the review's remedy of listing only open days (which it says fixes this and #2 together) would fix D06.
disagreements.b_reason: On phones the only sign that a day is open is a tiny coloured dot, so older, low-vision or colour-blind members cannot reliably tell open days from closed ones. This is distinct from D06 (closed days selectable and refused late), though it makes that mistake more likely; labelling 'Open' at every size would not by itself fix D06.

assertions.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
